question: Evaluate $\int e^x (\cot x + \log \sin x) dx$.
explanation:
Note that $\frac{d}{dx}(\log\sin x)=\cot x$.

Thus the integrand becomes $e^x[f(x)+f'(x)]$ where $f(x)=\log\sin x$.

Using $\int e^x[f(x)+f'(x)]dx=e^x f(x)+C$.

Hence the result is $e^x\log(\sin x)+C$.
